dz: 卡斯蒂利亚的亨利三世派鲁伊·冈萨雷斯·德·克拉维霍出任驻蒂穆尔大使,讨论蒂穆尔和卡斯蒂利亚结盟反对奥斯曼帝国的可能性.
de: Henry III of Castile sends Ruy González de Clavijo as ambassador to Timur to discuss the possibility of an alliance between Timur and Castile against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 英格兰国王亨利四世在英格兰郡城镇什罗普郡以北击败了叛军.
te: King Henry IV of England defeats rebels to the north of the county town of Shropshire, England.
dz: 什鲁夫斯伯里战役:英格兰国王亨利四世在英格兰郡城镇什罗普郡以北击败了叛军.
de: Battle of Shrewsbury: King Henry IV of England defeats rebels to the north of the county town of Shropshire, England.

t: 由法国上将所领导的热那亚分舰队被威尼斯分舰队在摩登战役所击败.
te: The Genoese fleet under a French admiral is defeated by a Venetian fleet at the Battle of Modon.
dz: 威尼斯-格诺埃塞战争:由法国上将所领导的热那亚分舰队被威尼斯分舰队在摩登战役所击败.
de: Venetian–Genoese wars: The Genoese fleet under a French admiral is defeated by a Venetian fleet at the Battle of Modon.
